title: Module geometric stalks compute and detect unbounded cohomology
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Work on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every geometric point $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ [def-weil-geometric-point], the stalk functor $s_{\bar t}:\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], with the induced $A$-action, is exact. Forgetting module structures commutes with kernels, images, quotients and cohomology. Termwise $s_{\bar t}$ preserves quasi-isomorphisms and induces a functor on the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], denoted $E\mapsto E_{\bar t}$. For every $E\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$ there is a natural $A$-linear isomorphism
$$ (\mathcal H^i(E))_{\bar t}\cong H^i(E_{\bar t}), $$
with cohomology sheaves as in [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Moreover
$$ \mathcal H^i(E)=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad H^i(E_{\bar t})=0\text{ for every geometric point }\bar t. $$
No boundedness, finiteness, constructibility or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03PT (lemma-stalk-exact), clause (3), and Tag 03PU (theorem-exactness-stalks), applied to underlying abelian sheaves of constant-coefficient modules; the cohomology comparison used in sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0DJJ (lemma-tor-amplitude-stalk), converse proof

proof.text: For the coefficient forgetful functor ModuleCat A -> AddCommGrpCat, limits are preserved by the existing ModuleCat instances, and colimits by ModuleCat.forget₂CoinduceAdj. For its sheafCompose on the small etale site, compose with sheafToPresheaf: this is sheafToPresheaf followed by coefficient whiskering, so it preserves finite limits; sheafToPresheaf reflects them. The existing Sheaf.forget₂CoinduceAdj makes this sheaf forgetful functor a left adjoint, hence it preserves colimits as well. Apply [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology] to each of these two additive exact functors: PreservesImage.iso supplies the image comparison and mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso supplies the natural cohomology comparison. This proves both auxiliary forgetful assertions without changing coefficient encodings.

The pointed-neighbourhood colimit of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is already computed in ModuleCat A by Point.sheafFiber, so the module structure and linearity of its maps are part of the coefficient category. Apply the coefficient-general instances underlying [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact] directly with ModuleCat A: filtered colimits commute with finite limits, giving finite-limit preservation; the skyscraper adjunction gives finite-colimit preservation. Point.sheafFiber_additive gives additivity from binary biproduct preservation. All three claims are existing instances or proved APIs; no reduction through abelian groups is needed.

source.place: Construction immediately before Tag 04EQ (lemma-stalk-exact-modules); etale-cohomology.tex Definition 040R (definition-stalk)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] to the additive exact module stalk functor from step 2. The natural comparison on consecutive terms implies that a quasi-isomorphism remains a quasi-isomorphism after termwise application; this is exactly HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology. The complexes are arbitrary integer-indexed complexes.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] to the same exact module stalk. Its mapDerivedCategoryFactors is precisely the required natural isomorphism Q followed by the derived stalk versus the termwise stalk followed by Q. No resolution or boundedness assumption occurs.

source.place: Tag 010N (lemma-exact-functor), applied to consecutive terms; derived.tex Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor)

proof.text: The natural unbounded derived cohomology comparison is the existing mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, the first assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below], specialized to the module stalk. This is an isomorphism of functors into ModuleCat A, so it is A-linear. Its construction localizes the complex comparison of step 3 using step 4 and the representative comparison for [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Only the unbounded cohomology assertion of the cited generic theorem is used.

Put F = H^i(E). If F is zero, its module stalk is zero because the stalk functor preserves zero morphisms. Transport across the comparison of step 5 to deduce vanishing of H^i of every derived stalk. Conversely suppose the latter vanish. Step 5 makes each stalk of F zero. Use the module-valued jointly faithful form of [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative], Scheme.sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint, on id_F and 0. At the algebraic closure of each residue field, both maps coincide because that stalk is zero. Thus id_F = 0, which is equivalent to F being a zero object. The same jointly faithful theorem applies to the empty scheme; there are then no pointwise goals.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03PT(3), 03PU and 04EQ; derived.tex Tag 015F. Lean uses the existing coefficient-general stalk exactness and jointly faithful geometric-stalk APIs directly in ModuleCat A, the coefficient and sheaf coinduction adjunctions for forgetting, and the existing natural unbounded derived-homology comparison.
